meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Removes AI-generated code smells from branch changes or an explicit file list behind regression tests. Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 清理代码中AI生成的坏味道与冗余痕迹
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常担心AI助手留下的代码不够干净
copy.tagline_en: Clean up AI-generated code smells and redundant patterns in your recent changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often worry about messy code left by AI assistants

howto.what: 它能清理代码改动里由 AI 生成的冗余内容：无用注释、重复代码、用不上的旧代码、过于绕的做法等。清理前会用能通过的测试把现有功能锁住；清理中分类分批处理；清理后跑自动检查，验证不过就还原或修正。
howto.when: 当用户要求清理最近改动、deslop 代码改动、或移除改动里的 AI-slop 模式时触发。默认处理当前分支与 main 的差异；若指定了文件列表，则只处理这些文件。

say.text: 把我最近改动里的 AI 冗余清理掉，但别改坏功能。
say.note: 会先跑测试锁定现有行为，再开始清理。

say.text: 只给 a.py 和 b.py 这两个文件去去 AI 味。
say.note: 处理范围将只包含这两个文件。

say.text: 帮我 deslop 一下这次分支改动。
say.note: 这会触发完整的清理流程。

howto.what_en: Claude cleans AI slop from branch changes or a given file list. It pins current behavior with regression tests, removes unneeded comments, dead code, duplication and complexity, runs quality gates; on failure it reverts or direct-edits.
howto.when_en: Triggers when user asks to clean up recent changes, deslop changes, or remove AI-slop patterns. Default scope is the diff vs main; an explicit file list overrides.

say_en.text: Clean the AI slop out of my recent changes but don't break anything.
say_en.note: It pins current behavior with regression tests before editing.

say_en.text: Only remove AI redundancies in a.py and b.py.
say_en.note: It will restrict the cleanup scope to those two files.

say_en.text: Deslop this branch's recent changes, please.
say_en.note: That runs the full cleanup workflow on this branch's diff.
